description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity for a leader committed to providing exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment.As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing nursing operations, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and supporting the Director of Nursing. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about making a lasting impact and is seeking a stable, long-term career path within our compassionate team.
requirements: Current and valid Registered Nurse (RN) license
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a supervisory nursing role, preferably as an Assistant Director of Nursing
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility (SNF) environment
Demonstrated leadership abilities and strong clinical judgment
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position
